_: Written by `ci-video narrate`. Records which line each mp3 is a read of, in which voice, on which engine, at what prosody — so a later edit to any of those can be detected instead of silently keeping the old recording. Commit this with the mp3s.

ask-a-question.text: Ask from your offline field library. A model you run writes the answer.

check-the-sources.text: Open the source passages and verify the answer before you act.

first-launch.text: Start with an empty library whose state is clear.

field-library.text: Copy your reference documents into the source volume and let ingestion index them.

no-model-no-panic.text: If no language model is installed, the app says so and the library stays browseable.

recap.text: Just In Case is designed to keep working when the network does not.

close.text: Build your offline field library with Just In Case. Visit ci dot computer. UnCloud your life.
